form.photoTitle: Take a photo of the scene
form.photoHint: Take the photo before turning off the lights. Capture the empty classroom with lights and AC clearly on.
form.criteriaIntro: Points are awarded when all of the following conditions are met.
form.criteriaOffHours: Empty classroom outside operating hours (not reportable during scheduled power-on times)
form.criteriaWaste: Lights or air conditioning turned on

form.photoGuideClassroom: If the classroom is not visible, photograph a classroom with visible chairs and desks
form.photoGuideLighting: Capture ceiling lights and AC status clearly
form.photoGuideWide: The full room is not required — chairs and desks visible in frame are enough
form.photoPlaceholder: Select a photo from camera or gallery
form.changePhotoHint: Tap to select a different photo
form.affiliationMissing: Affiliation is not set. Please register your affiliation in profile.
form.noReportableRooms: No rooms available for reporting right now. Please try again after operating hours.
form.loadingDescription: Checking the classroom photo and detecting energy waste.
form.errorPhotoRequired: Please take or select a scene photo.
form.errorPhotoAndLocationRequired: Please select both photo and location.
form.errorSubmitFailed: An error occurred while submitting the report.
form.errorAbuseAgreeRequired: Please agree to the anti-abuse notice before submitting.
form.abuseNoticeIntro: The following acts are strictly prohibited to maintain trust in crowd-sourced energy reporting.
form.abuseNoticeItem1: Turning on lights or AC yourself and reporting to earn points
form.abuseNoticeItem2: False or manipulated reports, or misusing others' reports
form.abuseNoticePenalty: Violations may result in point clawback, reward exchange restrictions, or account suspension.
form.abuseAgreeLabel: I have read the notice above and will only report waste I actually discovered.
